smallshipsheraldry.help.title: Heraldry editor help
smallshipsheraldry.help.print: Left-click the paper slot to add one sheet; Shift adds all. Right-click returns paper. Press Print, then collect the output.
smallshipsheraldry.help.ship: Sneak and use the pattern on a matching ship. Sneak and use shears to remove an installed pattern.
smallshipsheraldry.help.paint: In Paint mode, LMB uses the tool. RMB rotates; Shift+RMB or MMB pans. The wheel zooms and Alt+LMB temporarily picks a colour.
smallshipsheraldry.help.elements: In Parts mode, LMB selects. Ctrl and Shift select several parts; RMB toggles visibility. The isolate button hides everything else.
smallshipsheraldry.help.tools: B/E/I/F select brush, eraser, picker and fill. L toggles freehand/line. Fill supports area, face and colour replacement.
smallshipsheraldry.help.colors: LMB selects a saved colour; RMB or Shift+LMB overwrites it.
smallshipsheraldry.help.opacity: The bar below the picker controls opacity. Erasing makes pixels empty.
smallshipsheraldry.help.history: 1–5 or [ ] change sail stage. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo. Library saves patterns locally for use on other servers.
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.author: Author: %s
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.paper_slot: LMB: add paper · RMB: return · Shift: all
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.result_slot: Left-click to collect the printed pattern
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.duplicate: Surround with 8 paper in a crafting table to duplicate
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.install: Sneak + use on a matching ship to install
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.remove: Sneak + use shears on the ship to remove
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.mirror_vertic: Mirror left and right across the vertical axis
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.mirror_horizo: Mirror top and bottom across the horizontal axis
smallshipsheraldry.message.invalid_patte: This heraldry pattern is damaged or invalid
smallshipsheraldry.message.pattern_too_c: The pattern is too detailed to save. Undo or erase some isolated pixels.
